sourceTitle: Our People From the Collection of "Mr. Punch"
description: "Our People" by Charles Keene is a collection of illustrated sketches, published during the late 19th century. It features a series of humorous and satirical portrayals of various segments of English society, particularly drawing from the "Punch" magazine style.
